verdict.rationale: Square's docs explicitly cover a Refund Payments API and an Unlinked Refunds API (square-docs-13, square-docs-14), which supports issuing refunds programmatically, and full vs partial refunds are typically handled via amount parameters in such APIs. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation or screenshots confirming dashboard-based refund issuance (full or partial) for finance-ops users, only the API-side capability. Missing for 10: dashboard refund UI documentation, explicit confirmation of partial-refund amount support, and independent/hands-on verification of both flows.
